deep.reconstruction:
This page is a heavily corrected draft of the topological preliminaries in Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 54, 1857). It is the part where he constructs the canonical dissection of the Riemann surface T. The neighbouring pages are drafts of the covering letter to Borchardt ('Hochgeehrter Herr Doctor') and of a reply about Weissenborn and the methods borrowed from the dissertation. They place the page in 1856–57, during preparation of the Crelle paper.

The legible skeleton follows; much is illegible, and the content is cross-checked against the published §19-type passage.

(1) Claim. Dissection of T: "Es soll zunächst gezeigt werden, dass eine solche Zerschneidung für jede 2p+1 fach zusammenhängende Fläche möglich ist." Let T be a closed Riemann surface of connectivity 2p+1, i.e. genus p. T is to be cut into a simply connected T' by cross-cuts a_1,…,a_p, b_1,…,b_p. They must satisfy the following conditions.
- a_1,…,a_p are closed curves.
- b_μ runs from the positive side of a_μ back to its negative side, returning to the same point, so it crosses a_μ exactly once.
- Auxiliary lines c_μ connect the system.
- The jump of a function (the Abelian integral) across a_μ, b_μ, and across the c_μ, must be constant along all points of each line: "für alle Punkte der … constant sein". This is the condition that the periods are well defined.

(2) Construction. "Die Zerlegung der Fläche T wurde nicht [wie bisher] durch lauter in sich zurücklaufende Querschnitte, sondern folgendermaßen ausgeführt." The steps are:
- Cut T along a closed, non-separating curve a_1.
- Draw a cross-cut b_1 from the positive side of a_1 to its negative side, ending at its own starting point. The surface is still connected and has one boundary component, made of a_1± and b_1±.
- From a point of this boundary draw a line c_1 to a new closed curve a_2. Then draw b_2 from the positive side of a_2 back to its negative side.
- In general, the (2ν+1)-th cross-cut consists of the line c_ν together with the closed curve a_{ν+1}. The c_ν leads from the end point of b_ν, i.e. from the existing boundary, to a_{ν+1}.
- Each step lowers the connectivity by 1. After 2p cross-cuts the connectivity is (2p+1)−2p = 1, so T' is simply connected.

(3) Picture. The sketch of circles labelled a_1, b_1, c_1, b_2, a_2, c_2 illustrates this chained configuration of handle cuts joined by connecting lines.

(4) Orientation convention (bottom lines). Lines a and b meet in one point. The line b leads from the positive side of a onto its negative side, and a correspondingly lies with respect to the positive side of b. In modern terms the intersection number is a_μ·b_ν = δ_{μν}, and a_μ·a_ν = b_μ·b_ν = 0.

Purpose: to define the moduli of periodicity of the integrals of the first kind across a_ν and b_ν. A function single-valued on T' then has constant jumps across a_ν and b_ν and none across c_ν, since the c_ν are only connectors. This prepares the period relations and the theta series of the 1857 paper.
errors: No mathematical error is detectable in the legible text.

The draft does not explicitly justify why each new closed cut a_{ν+1} can be chosen non-separating. The justification is the connectivity count (connectivity > 1 implies a non-separating closed curve exists), and that count is presupposed from the earlier Analysis-situs sections.

results.what: Existence of a canonical system of 2p cross-cuts a_ν, b_ν (with connecting lines c_ν) reducing a (2p+1)-fold connected closed surface to a simply connected one.
results.modern_name: Canonical dissection / canonical homology basis (symplectic basis, normal form of a genus-p surface as a 4p-gon)
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann 1857 (Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen); later made rigorous by C. Jordan and by Möbius/Klein-style classification of surfaces

results.what: Convention that b_ν runs from the positive to the negative side of a_ν, giving intersection numbers a_μ·b_ν = δ_{μν}.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft of material printed in Riemann's 1857 Crelle paper on Abelian functions. Its only interest is the editorial evolution of the wording (struck alternatives, sketch) and its association with the Borchardt letter and the Weissenborn reply.

checkable.asserts: The intersection matrix of the canonical basis a_ν, b_ν is unimodular (det 1)
The intersection form is antisymmetric (gives the zero matrix)
The 4p-gon with all vertices identified (V=1, E=2p, F=1) has Euler characteristic 2-2p, consistent with genus p

transcription_corrections: The line read as 'Die Zerlegung der Fläche T wurde nicht [?] ... durch ... zusammenhängende Querschnitte, sondern ...' is better read 'nicht wie bisher durch lauter in sich zurücklaufende Querschnitte, sondern folgendermaßen ausgeführt.'
The bottom line should read approximately 'Der (2ν+1)te Querschnitt besteht aus c_ν und der ... a_{ν+1}', with the connecting line running from b_ν (its end point) to a_{ν+1}.
'a, b und b_1' near the bottom likely refers to lines a_ν, b_ν meeting in one point.
The left-margin insertion near the top appears to mention 'Doctordissertation' and 'Herstellung'; this links to the draft letter on the previous page.
